versions.content:  For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 32 to 127 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and  for Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTi meMaster equals True ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ) the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation that has been set by StbM_SetRateCorrection() for that Time Base. If no rate deviation has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .

 For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 32 to 127 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and  for Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 and StbMIsSystemWideGlo balTimeMaster equals True ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ) the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation that has been set by StbM_SetRateCorrection() for that Time Base. If no rate devia tion has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .

 For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 32 to 127 ( ECUC_StbM_00021 : ) and  for Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 and StbMIsSystemWideGlo balTimeMaster equals True ( ECUC_StbM_00036 : ) the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation() the rate deviation that has been set by StbM_SetRateCorrection() for that Time Base. If no rate devia tion has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation() shall return E_NOT_OK .

• For Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 32 to 127 and • for Time Bases with StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseIdentifier 0 to 31 and StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster equals TRUE the StbM shall return on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation the rate deviation that has been set by StbM_SetRateCorrection for that Time Base. If no rate deviation has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation shall return E_NOT_OK .

• For Synchronized and Offset Time Bases, – if StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster equals TRUE • and for Pure Local Time Bases on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation the StbM shall return the current rate deviation. If no rate deviation has been set, StbM_GetRateDeviation shall return E_NOT_OK .

• For Synchronized Time Bases, if StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster equals TRUE • and for Pure Local Time Bases on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation the StbM shall return the current rate deviation. If • no rate deviation has been set, • or rate deviation has been reset during clone operation (refer to [SWS_StbM_00535]) then StbM_GetRateDeviation shall return E_NOT_OK.

• For Synchronized Time Bases, if StbMIsSystemWideGlobalTimeMaster equals TRUE • and for Pure Local Time Bases on invocation of StbM_GetRateDeviation the StbM shall return the current rate deviation. If • no rate deviation has been set, • or rate deviation has been reset during clone operation (refer to [SWS_StbM_00535]) then StbM_GetRateDeviation shall return E_NOT_OK .
